title: Research Paper RAG
description: A RAG system that ingests research papers into a vector database and uses the retrieved context for LLM inference. The agent and vector store are connected; an ingestion API is still to come.

title: Review Manager
description: Semantic search over posted JSON reviews, using the local all-mpnet-base-v2 embedding model. APIs cover record retrieval, database status, and environment health checks.

title: Wireless Sensor Network Simulator
description: A network simulator that records per-message latency, sender, receiver, size, and energy, and is built to compare custom transmission protocols. Visualisation of live latency metrics is part of the design.
